scripts.build: tsc && find credentials nodes -name '*.svg' -o -name '*.png' | while read f; do dir="dist/$(dirname $f)"; mkdir -p "$dir"; cp "$f" "$dir/"; done
scripts.prerelease: git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: release prep'
scripts.release-patch: npm run prerelease && npm version patch && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release-minor: npm run prerelease && npm version minor && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release-major: npm run prerelease && npm version major && git push && git push --tags
